description: This file defines an Android Fragment called HomeFragment that displays a grid of recipe cards with search and pull-to-refresh functionality. It manages UI components, interacts with a data repository, and handles user interactions such as navigation to recipe details and toggling favorites.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment for displaying a grid of recipes with search and refresh features.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the DataRepository instance when fragment is attached to context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, sets up UI components, and attaches event listeners for search and swipe refresh.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Loads data each time the fragment resumes.

methods.name: openDetail
methods.description: Navigates to the recipe detail fragment for the selected recipe.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe asynchronously.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads recipe data based on search query with coroutine handling.
